n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
b = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Calculate the initial sum of absolute differences
initial_sum = sum(abs(a_i - b_i) for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b))

# Find the maximum difference that can be reduced by swapping
max_diff = 0
for i in range(n):
    max_diff = max(max_diff, abs(a[i] - b[i]))

# The minimum possible value is the initial sum minus the maximum difference
# if we can reduce the difference by swapping
min_possible_sum = initial_sum - max_diff if max_diff > 0 else initial_sum

print(min_possible_sum)
